rule.metric_definition: EXP-020 workload gate-slice hit rate: slice hits over slice accesses made in the gate (first) MUL_MAT_ID node of each layer, prefill + decode, workload requests only (warm-up and flush sentinel excluded); computed by argine.research.rawlog.node_attributed_outcomes from the research trace of the launch. It is the runtime field `expert_level_hit_rate`, not the expert-event decode-only counterfactual metric of the EXP-009 pilot.
rule.aggregation: arithmetic mean of the two scheduled 30B diag launches at 768 MiB, both of which must be H-5-eligible; individual launches and dispersion reported; no launch-level vote
rule.eligibility: launch outcome VALID, manifest publication_quality true, trace complete over the workload, budget_violations == 0
rule.falsified_if: both scheduled launches eligible and their mean > 0.30
rule.otherwise: both eligible and mean <= 0.30: NOT FALSIFIED BY THIS TEST; formal status INCONCLUSIVE
rule.not_evaluable: fewer than 2 eligible launches for any reason (or the 30B diag block incomplete): H-5 NOT EVALUABLE, formal status INCONCLUSIVE, reported with the outcomes observed at 768 MiB; no replacement launch and no retry
rule.positive_support_note: No positive support threshold is introduced. The 2026-10-03 prediction recorded only a falsification condition; any support bound chosen now (e.g. <=10%, <=2%, a fraction of the 1.5G anchor) would be selected after the pilot values were known. Agreement with the predicted range may be reported descriptively only.

notes: usability labels are frozen reporting conventions, not hypothesis thresholds
STORE_RESIDENCY_ABORT is its own category, never converted to NON_INTERACTIVE, and does not by itself mean the budget is physically infeasible
the 80B arm is exploratory: descriptive only
runtime-style hit rates and process-total store counters are labelled and include warm-up
replay fidelity, where run, is diagnostic and never excludes a launch
